title: Customer activity lookup degraded after supporting index disappeared
customer_impact: Customer activity-history lookups are slower than the established indexed baseline; core ticket creation and processing remain available.
scope: Degradation is isolated to the customer_activity lookup path. PostgreSQL remains reachable and there is no evidence of a database-wide outage.

timeline.event: Performance regression reported for customer activity lookup while core service health remained green.
L2 acknowledged the P3 degradation and captured database state before changing anything.
pg_indexes showed idx_customer_activity_customer_time was absent; pg_stat_activity did not show lock or connection saturation evidence.
EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS) confirmed the customer lookup had regressed from the composite index to a sequential scan.
Approved simulated database change recreated the composite index concurrently and refreshed planner statistics.
Recovery verification confirmed the indexed plan returned and the query produced the expected 20-row result.

evidence: PostgreSQL remained reachable during the degradation
customer_activity contains deterministic high-volume workload data
EXPLAIN ANALYZE showed sequential scan during incident state
pg_stat_activity captured before recovery to check state/waits
composite index restored through approved simulated change
post-change EXPLAIN returned to index-backed plan
customer lookup returned expected result set after recovery
resolution: After L2 proved the missing-index query-plan regression and captured database evidence, the approved simulated recovery recreated idx_customer_activity_customer_time concurrently, analyzed the table, and verified the index-backed plan and result set.
